events.title: Fall Bodyroll in the Field House
events.description:
Bodyroll is a dance practice pulsing with pure joy. Classes ignite embodied empowerment and energize a cathartic release. The experience is designed to alchemize a playful perspective for rolling, releasing, and reinventing yourself. Together, we’ll tap into the spiral rave through body rolling, movement energetix, embodiment practices, and aerobic dancing. No dance experience is encouraged! No class November 23.

This event takes place in the newly-renovated 102nd Street Field House. Enter the Park at 102nd Street and Riverside Drive, then descend to the promenade level. The stairs to the Field House are across the promenade at 102nd Street.

events.title: Bodyweight Blast in the Field House
events.description:
Join instructor Natalie Hahn for 45 minutes of bodyweight exercises, combining cardio and strength for a full-body workout. This class is high-energy with programming options for all levels!

Bring your own mat. This event takes place in the newly-renovated 102nd Street Field House. Enter the Park at 102nd Street and Riverside Drive, then descend to the promenade level. The stairs to the Field House are across the promenade at 102nd Street.
events.excerpt: Join us for 45 minutes of bodyweight exercises, combining cardio and strength for a full-body workout. This class is high-energy with programming options for all levels!

events.title: Fall Yoga in the Field House
events.description:
Join Yoga instructor Meg SantaMaria for a morning practice. Suitable for all fitness levels. Please wear loose, comfortable clothing and bring your own mat. No class November 25.

This event takes place in the newly-renovated 102nd Street Field House. Enter the Park at 102nd Street and Riverside Drive, then descend to the promenade level. The stairs to the Field House are across the promenade at 102nd Street.

events.title: Holiday on the Hudson
events.description:
Celebrate the season with a holiday tree lighting, live music, decoration making, and hot chocolate (while supplies last). Tree lighting at 5:30pm, rain date Sunday, December 6. 

Summer on the Hudson events are free and open to the public. Seating is limited, unreserved, and available on a first-come, first-served basis. If there is heavy rain at the time of the event, the event will be canceled. For weather updates, check nyc.gov/parks/soh 2 hours before the event.

events.title: PlacePartner Opportunity: Sunset Gardening at W 153rd St
events.description:
Date: 3rd Friday of every month

Time: 5pm – 7pm

Meeting Location: W 153rd St and Riverside Drive

Project Details: During this sunset event, we’ll be working together to clean up the park and weed out introduced species. It’s a great opportunity to meet new people, enjoy the outdoors, and contribute to the well-being of our community.

No prior experience is necessary – just bring your energy and enthusiasm! We’ll provide all the necessary tools and equipment. Don’t forget to wear comfortable clothing and shoes, and bring a water bottle to stay hydrated.

This project is not suitable for corporate groups! If you are a corporate group, please email caroline@riversideparknyc.org to set up a project.

events.title: ¡EN ESPAÑOL! Tree Club del Bosque de West Harlem
events.description:
¡Sea parte de Tree Club del Bosque de West Harlem!

Fecha: Cuarto sábado

Hora: 1:30 pm a 3:00 pm

Lugar de reunión: W 143rd St y Riverside Drive

Detalles del proyecto: Durante este evento, trabajaremos juntos para limpiar el parque, desmalezar y eliminar especies introducidas y cuidar nuestros árboles. Esto es parte de un nuevo proyecto de restauración llamado Bosque de West Harlem. ¡Ven a aprender y a restaurar 7.5 acres con nosotros!

No se necesita experiencia, ¡solo trae tu energía y entusiasmo! Le proporcionaremos todas las herramientas y equipos necesarios. No olvides llevar ropa cómoda y zapatos cerrados(como botas o tenis), y llevar una botella de agua para mantenerte hidratado.

¡Este proyecto no es apto para grupos corporativos! Si es un grupo corporativo, envíe un correo electrónico a danny@riversideparknyc.org para configurar un proyecto.
